i.norm: Verifies that disabling features that were originally enabled produces a brand-new {@link JsonFormat.Features} instance which is no longer equal to the original one (since the same feature is now disabled rather than enabled).
Build a Features value where WRITE_SINGLE_ELEM_ARRAYS_UNWRAPPED is both listed as enabled and disabled (the same feature appears twice in the array).
Disabling the same feature flips its state, producing a new instance.
